tickets.title: Universal statusline on the herdr pane strip, opt-in per client
tickets.what: Spec §2.2 (26.02): a universal statusline drawn by herdr for every client may follow; native statuslines stay until it matches them. With the pane-strip capability (herdr-fork/10, first used by codexH in herdr-fork/13), HUD can push its compact line to a bottom strip of a Claude Code, pi or Antigravity main session, at the exact width from the fork's width event, using the same renderer and facts as the native line (this session / this machine split, drop optional fields to fit). Off by default; a per-client setting in panel Settings turns it on; native statuslines are untouched. A parity check compares the strip line with the native line on the same synthetic state.

acceptance.text: Parity tests: for Claude, pi and Antigravity synthetic states the strip line equals the native line at 40/80/120 columns
Off by default; turning it on for one client affects only that client's main sessions; turning it off returns the row to the PTY (fake fork tests)
Owner try: turn it on for pi: the strip shows the same line as pi's native statusline; turn it off: the row is gone

tickets.title: One role icon table: herdr sidebar uses the bar's icons; sonic ϟ, lead ★
tickets.live_try: dispatch a sonic and an imp, then compare the herdr sidebar icon with the statusline worker zone (same glyph per role)
tickets.what: Owner 2026-11-26: the herdr sidebar role icons (herdr-fork/19, `hudRoleIcons` in src/mcp/dispatch/direct-exec.ts: imp ◆, reviewer ◎, lead ★, sonic » ...) differ from the statusline's; main's ticket wrongly invented a second table. Owner choice: one table everywhere. (1) Delete `hudRoleIcons`; the `hud_icon` metadata token uses `roleIcon(role)` from src/render/model-glyphs.ts with the owner's `icons` setting (unicode / ascii / nerd), read where the job is dispatched. (2) In ROLE_GLYPHS change sonic's unicode glyph from ⚡ (U+26A1, emoji presentation, two cells, too wide for the one-cell sidebar state slot) to ϟ (U+03DF, one cell); ascii and nerd stay. (3) Add `lead: ['★', 'L', '']` (Font Awesome star, BMP) to ROLE_GLYPHS, placed so the bar order stays sonic last and other before it. (4) Keep the native statusline copy (native/src/render.rs role table) in sync and the parity tests green; update any docs (docs/reference.md icon table, statusline docs) and render tests that name ⚡ or the old sidebar glyphs. Every glyph sent as `hud_icon` in each icon set must be exactly one terminal cell (unicode-width 1, no emoji presentation); add a test over all roles and sets. Removes: the separate sidebar icon table only (no user-visible feature).

acceptance.text: hud_icon for each role equals roleIcon(role) in the configured icon set; the separate sidebar table is gone
sonic shows ϟ and lead shows ★ in the bar, pi footer, Home and sidebar token; ascii and nerd sets have lead entries
TS and native statusline tables match (parity tests pass)
A test asserts every role glyph in every icon set is one terminal cell wide
